author: The Infographics Show
description:
In December 2010, the body of high-level Pentagon consultant John P. Wheeler III was discovered in a Delaware landfill.
No suspects and no clear motive. Just another tragic death, at least officially.

But Wheeler wasn’t the only defense insider to die under bizarre circumstances.
Across the U.S. and UK, scientists, engineers, aerospace researchers, and military contractors connected to advanced defense projects have turned up dead, disappeared, or died in ways that left investigators with more questions than answers.
Some were tied to cyberwarfare, others worked around missile systems, nuclear research, propulsion technology, or classified aerospace programs.

And the deeper you look, the stranger the pattern becomes.

title: 12 U.S. Scientists Have Gone Missing or Died. What's Going On?
